questions.question: Sunette Loubser set a database record (10/11 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 53. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Sunette Loubser.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 146, against Kei on 2018/11/18.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Boland?
How many runs separate the all-time #1 (Delmi Tucker) and #2 (Tazmin Brits) run-scorers (combined T20 + List A) in the 21/22 season?
questions.explanation: Delmi Tucker: 409 — Tazmin Brits: 390 — a gap of 19.

questions.question: At which ground did M Motshabi record their career-best bowling figures (4-26, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2019/01/19.

questions.question: Which player in the database (2005 onwards) only represented South Africa in the test format?
